title: Commit a fix and preserve a draft
task: Create exactly one commit from the starter. Commit only the fix in app.cfg. Preserve the draft edits in notes.md as unstaged changes, with a clean index.
hints: Use git add app.cfg and inspect git diff --cached.
Commit the staged fix and confirm notes.md is still unstaged.

checks.label: Exactly one new commit descends from the starter
The commit contains only the app configuration fix
checks.feedback: Review the paths and contents in the commit.

checks.label: The draft remains available
checks.feedback: Restore the provided draft in the working tree.

checks.label: The index is clean
checks.feedback: Use git diff --cached and unstage the draft if needed.

quiz.prompt: Which diff previews the contents of the next commit?
quiz.explanation: git diff --cached compares the index with HEAD, so it previews the snapshot change.
